children: RNS Number : 8519Z  ABP Finance PLC  21 October 2026

ABP Finance Plc (the "Company") announces that CPP Investment Board Private Holdings (6) Inc ("CPPIB") and Borealis Ark Holdings B.V. and Borealis ABP Holdings B.V. (together, "OMERS") have entered into a binding agreement with Global Infraco Haven Bidco Limited, an indirect subsidiary of IFM Global Infrastructure Fund, for the sale and purchase of their combined 63.88% stake in ABP (Jersey) Limited and its subsidiaries (including the Company and Associated British Ports) (the "ABPJ Group"). The completion of the transaction is subject to certain conditions, including mandatory regulatory and national security filings.
